title: Programme Terms: Repair Programme Points on the Rental Vehicle Coordination Repair-Customer Discount
content:
**Programme term.** The program points of the repair-customer discount credit on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair are percentage points added to the credit's discount rate, and follow the discount program on the repair order under Customer-Pay Repairs: a returning-customer program adds the repair tier's returning-customer discount percent; a military program adds the repair tier's military discount percent; any other program adds zero.

## Programme table

| Discount program on the customer-pay repair order | Program points |
|---|---|
| Returning customer | The returning-customer discount percent of the repair's service tier under Customer-Pay Repairs |
| Military | The military discount percent of the repair's service tier under Customer-Pay Repairs |
| Any other program, or none | Zero |

## Basis Q&A

**Which repair order's program counts?** The customer-pay repair order the rental is tied to, and its own service tier's percentages.

**Is the points figure a fixed number for the rental programme?** No; it is the percentage that the repair's own service tier lists for the program carried, so two repairs in different service tiers can add different points.

**Hypothetical:** a customer-pay repair carrying the military program in a service tier whose military discount is 7 percent adds 7 points; the same repair with no program adds none.
